remarks: Welcome to this charming house. 680 Weed Street is a hidden gem in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods! This beautifully maintained home offers the perfect blend of classic New England charm and modern comfort, surrounded by lush greenery, a perfectly sited pool, and hot tub. All this located just steps from downtown New Canaan, parks and the train station A sun-filled living spaces, beautiful hardwood floors with an inviting layout are ideal for everyday living and entertaining!   Features include an expansive first floor primary suite with his and her bathrooms and large walk-in closets! Also included are: three additional bedrooms, two with en-suite bathrooms. The family room and dining room adjoin the kitchen making it ideal for family living and entertaining. The sunroom with wet bar, overlooks the heated gunite pool, hot tub and private back yard.   The serenity of the beautifully landscaped grounds provides a complete sense of privacy within walking distance to town.  Central air, a large basement/flex space, attached two car garage and ample storage throughout are included.  Additional opportunity! On property is a restored carriage house which could be a home office, or for gatherings or additional storage space. ($2,000 additional per month.)
